description: This file is a shell script used for testing the behavior of the 'help.autocorrect' configuration in Git. It sets up various test scenarios to verify how Git suggests or runs commands based on the 'help.autocorrect' setting, including alias commands, user-defined scripts, and different autocorrect modes.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs the specified commands, and checks for expected outcomes.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail, capturing output for verification.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares actual and expected output files.

methods.name: test_line_count
methods.description: Checks the number of lines in a file.
